charge_port.notes: Native NACS from model year 2027: GM says all 2027 EVs get native NACS (Electrek, GM spokesperson); 2027 pages for this model state it. US only.

supercharger_access.notes: Native NACS port on 2027 models (see charge_port); Superchargers usable without an adapter (Electrek / The Charge Port / EVChargingStations). US only.

ac_max_kw.notes: EPA vehicles.csv lists this car as "(11 kW Charger)" (rounded label; 11.5/19.2 kW from the NRCan labels and GM). Standard charger; the 19.2 kW version is a separate option.
EPA vehicles.csv lists this car as "(19 kW Charger)" (rounded label; 11.5/19.2 kW from the NRCan labels and GM).
